description: Route industrial/OT data-tap and troubleshooting tasks to the appropriate iaiops edition and governed MCP profile. Use for PLC/SCADA/CNC/RTU/IED, OPC-UA, Modbus, S7, MC, FINS, EtherNet/IP, EtherCAT, PROFINET, SECS/GEM, MTConnect, MQTT/Sparkplug, BACnet, HART, IO-Link and serial sensors; also factory, fab, process, building, water, pharma, clinical, warehouse, renewables and PLCnext work involving OEE, downtime, asset inventory or data quality. Read-first; device writes require MOC and are refused for safety: sis endpoints. Excludes IT/network gear, Kubernetes, hypervisors and backups.
